title: Stoic acceptance
description: Accepting what is outside one's control and attending to one's own response, against striving to change the external situation. The task asks for advice in setbacks; the target is the acceptance option. 48 pairs across short narratives, diary lines, dialogue, workplace messages, descriptions of a habit and maxims about concrete situations.
inspiration: Epictetus' dichotomy of control; Marcus Aurelius

learned.request: 48 matched pairs and a two-option task for stoic acceptance.
